title: ADB's July Lending Spree in India
summary: ADB approved a string of India loans this month spanning schools, water, cities, and solar — even as it trimmed its own India growth forecast.

blocks.content: ADB approved a string of India loans this month spanning schools, water, cities, and solar — even as it trimmed its own India growth forecast.

items: **B. Chennai water & sanitation:** $230M → Chennai becomes first Indian city with a comprehensive ring-main solution.
**C. Urban resilience:** $1 billion → supports Urban Challenge Fund (UCF), strengthens urban local body finances.
**D. Rooftop solar:** $850 million → speeds up PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana rollout.
